_note: Single source of truth for every figure and string that appears on a slide. build.py substitutes {{token}} placeholders in deck_template.html from this file. Nothing numeric is typed by hand into the markup. verify_figures.py re-derives every rendered figure from this file and diffs it against the built deck.html.

_provenance.scope_and_pricing: Supplied by Alon Rotem (the consultant) as his own engagement terms for this proposal. Not external research, not benchmarked against third-party data.
_provenance.credentials: Supplied by Alon Rotem about himself.
_provenance.venture_facts: Supplied by the client side (Ben / Ofek) — e.g. the 16-DJ roster and the incumbent tool iPlan.
_provenance.external_market_data: NONE. No market size, growth rate, competitor revenue, willingness-to-pay or adoption figure is asserted anywhere in this deck, because no sourced external dataset was supplied. Slide 5 deliberately poses willingness-to-pay as an open question rather than answering it.
_provenance.bio_source: Slide 7 of the presentation Alon supplied (fb2b3d7e-...pptx): role, degrees, disciplines, sectors, family and the portrait photograph are lifted from his own slide, not paraphrased.

conflicts.experience_years: The brief for this deck states 10+ years. Alon's supplied slide states 'למעלה מ-7 שנים'. These are not reconciled here: the brief's figure is used because it is the current instruction, and the supplied deck is demonstrably older (it lists the children as ages 7/5/3). Flagged rather than silently averaged.
conflicts.children_ages: The supplied slide gives ages 7/5/3. Those ages are stale by an unknown interval, so no age is printed — only the names.
conflicts.institution_name: The supplied slide says 'המרכז הבינתחומי הרצליה'. That institution is now Reichman University. Alon's own wording is kept.
